text:
alice.sec: Quick note-- we're running a keystore eviction + RBAC guardrails test tomorrow 11:00 PT for a private deployment. Objectives: validate audit continuity, RBAC rollback, and decrypt fallback under KMS outage. Need sec + infra + oncall.
ben.infra: I'll own networking. Plan to enforce default egress deny and allow only vault namespace and SIEM collector (5044). Applying a temporary netpol to test-app namespace. Snippet below.
carol.ops: For KMS sim we'll withdraw cloud-kms routes and switch the keystore config to `vault://local`. Then rotate a customer key and force revoke leases to trigger failures.
alice.sec: Logging: ensure audit entries contain `key_id`, `caller_sa`, and `action=decrypt`. Also add an auditd rule to capture execve for keystore agent: `-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S execve -k keystore-exec`.
ben.infra: netpol example:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: only-vault-and-siem
  namespace: test-app
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: vault
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8200
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.10.10.0/24
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5044
```
carol.ops: Rollback plan: if >10% decrypt failures persist for 90s, revert keystore config to cloud-kms, undo RBAC change using idempotent script, and mark incident. We'll timebox the test to 20 minutes and have an oncall ready.
alice.sec: Note CVE: keystore-agent CVE-2025-2020. We'll run patched image, but include a failure mode where the agent is crashed to exercise fallback. Security will run quick exploitability checks post-sim.
oncall-bot: runbook created: keystore-eviction-test-1768889999, assignees: ben.infra, carol.ops, alice.sec link: https://internal/runbooks/keystore-eviction-test-1768889999
ben.infra: I'll also add a synthetic decrypt event after rotation and assert SIEM ingestion within 45s. Post results to #eng-security-tests.
carol.ops: I'll prepare the idempotent RBAC rollback script and the decrypt canary (5s cadence). See you in the prep call 10:30 PT.
